newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet, BolsWessanen bid talk dismissed.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet, BolsWessanen bid talk dismissed.

text.p: Food and drinks group Grand Metropolitan Plc is unlikely to have a taste for Dutch spirits firm BolsWessanen NV despite takeover speculation that included GrandMet as a potential predator, drinks analysts said on Wednesday.

A GrandMet spokesman would not comment specifically on the rumours, but said the group's new chief executive John McGrath, who took over earlier this year, had stated on several occasions the company's strategy was to focus on organic growth rather than make major acquisitions.
"We will not be making major acquisitions, it's not part of the strategy," the spokesman said.
The takeover speculation boosted BolsWessanen's shares in Amsterdam, with Dutch trading group Hagemeyer also rumoured to be a potential suitor.
GrandMet's shares were down 1p at 469 by 1026 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
